correctness.rationale: The transformed equation zC+N, with C=v³+w³ and N=t(t³+w³), is primitive and linear in z because the forms have no common factor. The equations f_z=f_t=f_v=f_w=0, together with the surface equation, force w=v=t=0; the unique point is P. The cubic initial form in z=1 gives multiplicity three, and the defining equation and partial derivatives in the completed local ring generate (t⁴,v²,w²), since 1+t is a unit. The quotient has length 16. The hypersurface is S2 and regular in codimension one. Projection identifies the open set C≠0 with an open subset of P², and the directions C=N=0 are exactly those with w=1, v³=1 and t=0 or t³=1. This gives twelve geometric lines, two over F₂. Over F_q the rational locus of C=0 has 1+rq points (non-rational components can only contribute their common vertex). The r(r+1) rational base directions give q points each away from P, all other C=0 directions give none, and every C≠0 direction gives exactly one. This proves q²+q+1+r²q and hence the stated singular-surface zeta function. The frozen verifier and recorded output were inspected, not executed; the printed local-algebra statements are not independent computational checks. The proof covers every extension without relying on them.

evidence: The earlier exact model is resolved by blowing up the twelve reduced basepoints in P² and contracting the strict transforms of the three concurrent lines. The Rams–Schütt smooth-line result either excludes characteristic two or assumes smoothness; the normal-quartic singularity bound is not a substitute for the explicit resolution.

evidence: The rational blowup centers number r(r+1), so the blowup has #P²(F_q)+q r(r+1) points. A blowup at a non-rational center contributes no F_q-points. The exceptional fiber above P is the union of the three strict transforms through the common rational vertex; exactly r components are rational, and non-rational components contribute no point off the vertex. The fiber has 1+rq points. The earlier morphism is an isomorphism away from this fiber.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Replace the fiber's 1+rq points by P to get q²+q+1+r²q immediately. The parity of r then fixes the singular-surface zeta function. This is direct numerical specialization of verified earlier stronger coverage, not an inference from title or shared parameters.
